title: FOSAMAX PLUS D (alendronate sodium and cholecalciferol) tablets: full prescribing information
authors: US Food and Drug Administration; Organon LLC (labeler)
journal: DailyMed, US National Library of Medicine, set ID 10307e7e-9a84-4aa1-8c5c-4b209cffe4d1, version 10, effective 3 February 2026
funder: not stated; US prescribing information carries no funding statement.
result: The label has no boxed warning section. Section 5.2, cholecalciferol: the product alone should not be used to treat vitamin D deficiency, 'commonly defined as 25-hydroxyvitamin D level below 9 ng/mL'; vitamin D3 supplementation may worsen hypercalcemia and/or hypercalciuria in patients with diseases associated with unregulated overproduction of 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (for example leukemia, lymphoma, sarcoidosis), in whom urine and serum calcium should be monitored. Section 7: olestra, mineral oils, orlistat and bile acid sequestrants may impair absorption; anticonvulsants, cimetidine and thiazides may increase catabolism. Overdosage: signs of vitamin D toxicity include hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, polyuria, polydipsia, weakness and lethargy; dialysis to remove vitamin D would not be beneficial. Animal data: high doses of vitamin D2 in pregnant rabbits caused abortions and fetal aortic stenosis, and in pregnant rats neonatal death and impaired osteogenesis. In a 24-week extension, the proportion with hypercalciuria did not differ between 2800 and 5600 IU weekly.
